name: don-t-break-the-chain
title: Don't Break the Chain
description: Keep a mini calendar in your menu bar and cross off every day you show up, so you don't break the chain.
author: ramysamy

commands.name: chain-1
commands.title: Chain 1
commands.description: Shows a mini calendar in the menu bar and lets you cross off each day you showed up.

commands.name: chain-2
commands.title: Chain 2
commands.description: A second independent chain calendar in the menu bar.

commands.name: chain-3
commands.title: Chain 3
commands.description: A third independent chain calendar in the menu bar.

commands.name: chain-4
commands.title: Chain 4
commands.description: A fourth independent chain calendar in the menu bar.

commands.name: chain-5
commands.title: Chain 5
commands.description: A fifth independent chain calendar in the menu bar.

commands.name: export-calendar
commands.title: Export Calendars
commands.description: Writes every month of every chain to a text file, drawn just like the menu bar calendar.

preferences.name: exportFolder
preferences.title: Export Folder
preferences.description: Where the text file is written. Defaults to your Downloads folder.

preferences.name: weekStart
preferences.title: Week Starts On
preferences.description: Which day sits in the first column of the calendar.

preferences.name: cellStyle
preferences.title: Day Style
preferences.description: How each day is drawn on the calendar.

preferences.name: showDayLetters
preferences.title: Day Letters
preferences.label: Show day letters above the calendar
preferences.description: Draws M T W T F S S above the grid instead of leaving it bare.

preferences.name: name1
preferences.title: Chain 1 Name
preferences.description: Shown in the menu bar tooltip and in exports. Never drawn on the calendar.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
